messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx spike detected on api-gateway-main. Window=5m, 5xx_rate=6.3% (threshold 2.0%). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Pager -> mike (oncall).

mike: on it, joining bridge now :phone:  will start triage.

sara: seeing the spike concentrated in eu-west; total requests +110% last 10m. Many clients retrying aggressively after timeouts (observed ~30k retry attempts).

jonas: checking gateway metrics and pool state. looks like mux-proxy conn pool exhausted for backend fleet.

jonas: ```
[2026-03-17T14:02:12Z] mux-proxy: conn_pool_exhausted count=1248 route=/v1/generate backend=dedicated-01
[2026-03-17T14:02:15Z] mux-proxy: conn_pool_exhausted count=987 route=/v1/embeddings backend=quant-02
```

alisha: probable root: retry storm + long tail backend latency -> connection churn -> 502/504. Immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) throttle concurrency on hot routes, 2) enable upstream circuit-breaker, 3) shift traffic off busiest backends.

mike: applying throttles now. running: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: gateway-throttle-patch
data:
  /v1/generate.max_concurrency: "50"
  /v1/embeddings.max_concurrency: "40"
EOF`

incident-bot: CONFIG APPLIED: gateway-throttle-patch -> /v1/generate=50 /v1/embeddings=40.

sara: 60s after throttle: 5xx rate dropped to 1.9%, p95 latency on generate improved from 820ms -> 320ms. still seeing retry bursts from a subset of clients.

alisha: request to @growth-team (growth-api) to temporarily disable client-side aggressive retries for public SDKs / mobile clients. this will reduce fanout.

growth-api: paused client retry flag for public SDKs via remote config (flag: sdk.disableAggressiveRetries=true) at 14:07 UTC. will monitor.

mike: also shifting heavy inference traffic to eu-backup and scaling gateway pool +3 instances for headroom: `routectl scale gateway-eu +3`

jonas: enabled upstream circuit-breaker (fail_open=false, consecutive_errors=5, cooldown=30s) for dedicated backends.

ops-lead: customer-impact check: APM traces show ~420 unique customers saw >=1 failed request in window; revenue-impact low but degraded UX for some large customers. recommend status page note and postmortem.

incident-bot: MITIGATION: 5xx rate stable <1% for 5m. Auto-close alarm suppressed; creating follow-up ticket INC-2598765432 for RCA and mitigations (rate limiting policy, client SDK guidance, improved pool metrics).

mike: leaving page to infra oncall (sara) for post-incident actions. will write up quick runbook entry. :white_check_mark:

sara: ack. will start RCA and capture timeline. thanks team.
